description: This file contains test harness code for the Telegram bot media handling, including mocks, spies, and utility functions for testing media fetch, save, and bot interactions.

classes.name: telegramBotRuntimeForTest.Bot
classes.description: Mock class representing the Telegram bot used in tests, with stubbed methods for API interactions.

methods.name: resetUndiciFetchMock
methods.description: Resets the mock for the fetch function used by undici.

methods.name: defaultFetchRemoteMedia
methods.description: Default implementation for fetching remote media, throws if fetchImpl is missing, returns media buffer and headers.

methods.name: defaultSaveMediaBuffer
methods.description: Default implementation for saving media buffer, returns media info object.

methods.name: setNextSavedMediaPath
methods.description: Mocks the next media save operation to return specified path and metadata.

methods.name: resetSaveMediaBufferMock
methods.description: Resets the mock for saveMediaBuffer to default implementation.
